Fahranur, decimated and abandoned during the [[Scarab Plague]], was the ancient home of the [[Primeval Kings]] who once ruled all [[Elona]]. Some believe it also holds the key to the mystery of the Scarab Plague's origin. Superstitious fears and a bitter rivalry between the [[Excavations Corps]] and the [[Society of Engineers]] have kept work on this important archealogical site stagnant until recently. }} '''Jokanur Diggings''' is the base camp of excavation operations into the old ruins of Fahranur.
